source: make a tycoon game free to roam 3d very cool map. Tycoon about famous movies such as Jurassic Park, Avengers, DC, Spiderman brand new day etc make it 10 player per server. call it Movie tycoon. Include cool movies. and to claim your tycoon you can't choose your one at start of the game I want a menu screen play and a cool background when u press play u have to spin a wheel and you get whatever movie you land on. and the graphics have to be outstanding. and for every put there franchise logo and home logo so players no where is base. the rest I want perfect replica of a tycoon and also make it so when you level up each movie base gets there own special powers and weapons which people can fight eachother with. Make it also people can donate robux to game if they want to aka gamepasss make it also that u can get aura by leveling up. the more people u kill u get a higher bounty. put a obby somewhere where player can reach. Put some ai easy bots which don't give you much money but a bit if u kill it's for new players they can spend robux to get titles like sigma, skibidi, novice, skilled, Pro, Hacker, Godly. make godly, sigma and skibidi 150 rbx. and the rest 100 robux. no bugs whatsoever. and also put a Therealjokerxi78 title the best title in game for 1200 rbx. put a giant statue for me in game. put a store button for mobile and PC. all robux stuff should be in there ui.

answers.ask: Assumed district scale, 500-2000 studs, to hold ten bases plus an obby - should bases be walking distance apart or a drive?
answers.answer: Keep all bases within walking distance on a compact free-roam map; players should be able to reach other bases and the obby easily without needing vehicles.

answers.ask: The named franchises are licensed material - should the bases be recognisable homages built from generic parts instead?
answers.answer: Yes, use recognisable movie-inspired homages made with generic original parts, rather than direct licensed characters, assets, or exact replicas.

answers.ask: How many bases exist - exactly ten to match the server, or a larger wheel of franchises with unclaimed ones sitting empty?
answers.answer: Make exactly ten bases, one for each player slot, with the wheel assigning a movie-themed base when the player presses Play.

answers.ask: Is there a win condition, or is this an endless build-and-fight loop?
answers.answer: This is an endless tycoon build-and-fight loop with leveling, PvP bounty, auras, and upgrades; there is no final win condition.

## Enriched image prompt
Create an outstanding-quality compact free-roam movie tycoon district with exactly ten equally spaced player bases, all within easy walking distance. Give every base a distinct generic original movie-genre homage, an original cinematic emblem, and a clear home marker, without licensed characters, franchise assets, or exact replicas. Connect the ten plots through a central shared area dominated by one giant creator statue. Place one short 3D obby beside the common area, linked to the same walking network, and reserve neutral combat ground for easy training bots away from protected base entrances. Each tycoon plot begins as a clear upgrade footprint and can grow without overlapping its neighbors. Include no terminal reward structure because the build-and-fight loop is endless.

## Genre
The dominant genre is Simulation, specifically a multi-plot tycoon. Action is secondary because PvP and training-bot combat require shared clash ground; the single side obby is a layout feature rather than a third dominant genre.

## Shape and preset
Use `plot-isolated`, named Isolated Per-Player Plots: exactly ten independent tycoon bases grow without overlap around shared circulation. Preset is none; Tycoon assumes one shared team plot, while this author explicitly requires ten separately assigned bases.

## Config requirements
Use `path-circulation` for walking routes linking every base, the common area, and the obby. Use `social-hub`, taken from the shared catalogue, for the central common ground. Use `landmark-focal` for the single giant creator statue. Use `path-track`, taken from Obby & Platformer, for one short physics-valid side course. Use the visible side of `spawn-protected` for ten screened home entrances. Base emblems, home markers, and exterior upgrade footprints are scene-specific visible geometry.

## Layout requirements
Place exactly ten `spawn-protected` player starts, one at each assigned base entrance and out of immediate PvP sightlines. Add ten scene-specific Plot assignment anchors, one per base, for the wheel's result. No canonical option covers tycoon purchase buttons, so place scene-specific TriggerZones within each plot's upgrade footprint. Use `spawner-npc` for easy training-bot origins in the neutral combat ground, away from base starts and the obby.

## Layout components
The map contains ten equal non-overlapping base plots, one central common zone, one creator statue, one neutral bot-combat area, and one short obby. A compact path network keeps every destination walkable. Each plot has one original movie-inspired identity sign and one home marker. The exterior district boundary contains all plots without requiring vehicles.

## Render order
Use `topdown`: establish ten balanced plots, protected starts, shared circulation, bot ground, and a valid obby route before dressing the district.

## Scale, theme, and pipeline cost
The scale band is large, preserving the assumed 500–2000-stud district while keeping ten bases and the obby legible. The theme is high-fidelity generic movie homage built from original parts. Use `P6` for the side obby's valid platform route; the tycoon district itself stays on one exterior surface.
